bodySections.heading: Why Negotiation Is Essential in Sales
bodySections.content: Employers look for verified proficiency in Negotiation to ensure team productivity, project accuracy, and modern technical capability. Candidates with demonstrated Negotiation expertise consistently outperform those with only theoretical knowledge.
bulletPoints: Negotiation is listed as a required skill in over 60% of sales job postings.
Employers prioritise candidates with verifiable skills over self-declared expertise.
Proficiency in Negotiation accelerates career progression by 1–3 years on average.
Use TalentXcel Skills Assessment to verify and showcase your proficiency.

bodySections.heading: How to Learn and Demonstrate Negotiation
bodySections.content: The most effective way to build Negotiation proficiency is through a combination of structured learning, hands-on project work, and verified assessment. Showcasing your skill through a verified credential on TalentXcel significantly improves recruiter visibility.
bulletPoints: Start with structured online courses covering Negotiation fundamentals.
Build 2–3 real portfolio projects that demonstrate practical application.
Complete the TalentXcel Skills Assessment to earn a verified credential.
List the credential on your Career Passport and resume.
